entries: Hold two portions of raw flax and use Tie Flax Bundle to bind them with their own fibres. Use the bundle on fresh, non-irradiated water to ret it; click a submerged bundle to resume interrupted soaking.

Build a flax comb from eight softwood planks after Resource Processing. Load up to ten rotted flax and use the comb by hand three times to separate straw, tow and textile lint. Drag the comb onto yourself to recover an unfinished batch.
Use two tow in hand to spin one rope, or two textile lint to prepare one retted fabric for a loom. Completed soaking and combing stages survive interruptions and saves.
